name: zeroheight
description: The zeroheight MCP connects Claude directly to your design system documentation. Give your AI assistant access to your styleguide — components, tokens, patterns, and usage rules — so it can reference the right guidelines while generating code or answering questions about your design system.

_published_faq.name: How do I add zeroheight to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add zeroheight to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.zeroheight.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the zeroheight MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: zeroheight provides these MCP tools: get-page, get-page-asset, list-pages, list-releases, list-styleguides, and search-pages.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to zeroheight?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to zeroheight in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
zeroheight requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
